items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: I’m doing a little concert at the church... and that thing with a guy that I’m rehearsing with today, we’re in the middle of making an album, Jeff Colella

ctx.x: Okay. Well can you remember what’s the next gig that’s coming up for you?

I’m doing a little concert at the church, Pasadena Presbyterian and that thing with a guy that I’m rehearsing with today, we’re in the middle of making an album, Jeff Colella, a lovely piano player. We’re doing that now. We’re recording in a month. And work is very scarce, very scarce. And I’m at the point now where I turn down far more than I do because first of all I can’t play a four hour gig, it’s too long. I’m going to bed now by 10:00 at night. So a gig that ends at 9:00 is like oh man, there’s got to be…
I’m going to keep that in mind in the next few years.
